k01-room.observed_description: An empty classroom seen from the back: rows of small wooden one-person desks with chairs on a wooden floor face a blank white board on the front wall; a larger wooden desk stands at the front left under tall windows. No people and no writing.
k01-room.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Reads as a classroom at 180 px.

k02-class.observed_description: Six adult students sit close together at wooden desks with open notebooks and look at a woman in a blue polo shirt on the right who speaks to them with open hands; two students have a raised hand. A blank gray chalkboard is behind them. Nothing readable.
k02-class.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The people fill the photo, so it reads as a class, not a room.

k03-student.observed_description: A smiling young woman with shoulder-length brown hair, a mustard-yellow sweater and a dark backpack stands in a bright school corridor holding two thick plain books against her chest; closed wooden doors are blurred behind her. One person; the small notices on the far doors are blurred and unreadable.
k03-student.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: she stays whole inside the crop.

k04-desk.observed_description: One small school desk with a light-wood top, an open shelf under the top and four gray metal legs stands alone on a pale floor in front of a plain pale wall. No chair, nothing on the desk, no people.
k04-desk.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the whole desk stays inside the crop.

k05-pencil.observed_description: One yellow wooden pencil with a sharpened point, a silver metal band and a pink eraser lies diagonally on a plain light-gray table, seen from above. The body is plain; nothing else is on the table.
k05-pencil.note: Usable in 3:2 only: the pencil runs across about four fifths of the width, so a centered 4:5 crop would cut its point and eraser. The lesson keeps it out of four-card grids.

k07-paper.observed_description: A stack of blank white sheets of paper lies on a dark-brown wooden table, the top sheets slightly turned and one corner curled up, seen from above. Every sheet is blank; nothing else is on the table.
k07-paper.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the crop trims only a sliver of the stack's right edge and it still reads as paper.

k08-notebook.observed_description: One closed spiral notebook with a plain bright-blue cover and a silver spiral along its left edge lies on a light-gray table, seen from above at a slight angle; the white page edges show. Plain cover; nothing else on the table.
k08-notebook.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the whole notebook stays inside the crop.

k06-red-pencil.observed_description: The same pencil photograph with the body painted bright red instead of yellow: one red wooden pencil with a sharpened point, a silver band and a pink eraser lies diagonally on the light-gray table. Nothing else changed.
k06-red-pencil.note: Usable in 3:2 only, like its base: a centered 4:5 crop would cut the point and the eraser. Only the color differs from k05.

k09-green-notebook.observed_description: The same notebook photograph with a bright-green cover instead of blue: one closed spiral notebook with a silver spiral on its left edge on the light-gray table. Plain cover; nothing else changed.
k09-green-notebook.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop. Only the cover color differs from k08.

k10-ask.observed_description: In a bright room Luis (short curly black hair, navy T-shirt) stands on the left, holds one yellow pencil upright in his left hand and asks Ana a question with raised eyebrows and an open mouth, his other hand open palm up; Ana (long wavy black hair, olive-green shirt over a white top) stands on the right and looks at him. Two people; no writing.
k10-ask.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The same Ana and Luis as the reference; the pencil is thin but visible between them at 360 px.
